newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's AGF 1996 profit net up to 9.52 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's AGF 1996 profit net up to 9.52 bln pta.

text.p: Spanish insurance group AGF-Union Fenix reported on Monday a group profit of 9.52 billion pesetas ($66.2 million) versus a 3.59 billion pesetas loss in 1995.
The operating profit rose to 1.83 billion pesetas versus a loss of 3.395 billion at December 1995, a company statement said.
Financial profits rose 58 percent, mainly thanks to the selling of a single building in Madrid.
The statement said the profit will allow AGF to give a dividend to shareholders.
At around 1300 GMT AGF shares were trading at 1,510 pesetas, down 20 from Friday.
